title: How Does a Circuit Work?
hook: A bulb is a tiny closed racetrack for charge.
narration: A bulb is a tiny closed racetrack for charge.
A battery pushes charge around a complete loop.
Break the loop and the light dies.
Series shares one path. Parallel gives each bulb its own.
